Live Canvas Agent API
|-- [M] Modular structure: public boundaries and dependencies
|   |-- Agent-facing tool gateway
|   |   |-- MCP exposes schema-defined tools over stdio; forwards calls over HTTP
|   |   |-- Explicit canvas target -> cached attachment; chat token -> turn-bound target
|   |   `-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService
|   |       |-- Exposes call, callBound, direct diagram submission and argument resolution
|   |       |-- Keeps attachment lookup, dispatch, exec replay and save sequencing internal
|   |       `-- Validates schemas, read-only access and attachment/change-session agreement
|   |-- Canvas operations and domain services
|   |   |-- CanvasSessionPort -> CanvasSessionBridge -> owning browser's command handler
|   |   |-- AgentExecRuntime -> QuickJsAgentRuntime
|   |   |   `-- Scripts see frozen canvas, nodes and edges APIs; host calls pass through validation
|   |   |-- Shared semantic operations and current-state projections -> canvas domain
|   |   |-- DiagramEditService / DiagramBatchService -> generation and application
|   |   |-- ChangeSessionService -> proposal snapshots, mutations, review and acceptance
|   |   `-- Diagram service / repositories / context services -> saved diagrams and evidence
|   |-- Live selection and context boundary
|   |   |-- WebSocket /api/mapping/live: first frame selects publisher or reader role
|   |   |-- LiveCanvasService exposes selection reads, context, copy, paste and context upload
|   |   |-- Browser publisher owns selection updates; external readers receive bound snapshots
|   |   `-- HTTP selection reads support ETag; short-context reads expose epoch and version
|   `-- Compact identity boundary: CanvasApiProjection
|       |-- Projects nodes, content anchors, edges, jumps and migrations for API consumers
|       |-- Resolves incoming handles back to full domain IDs
|       `-- Grid projection omits rendering internals; domain state retains full IDs
|-- [C] Call model: representative activations across these boundaries
|   |-- Tool call -> HTTP tool endpoint -> session service
|   |   |-- Bound call -> capture target -> attach lazily -> validate requested operation
|   |   |-- exec -> runtime.run(code, invoke)
|   |   |   |-- Each canvas/nodes/edges call -> validate method and arguments
|   |   |   |-- Read -> browser read/snapshot or proposal snapshot -> API result
|   |   |   `-- Mutation -> check initial expectedVersion -> resolve handles -> semantic operation
|   |   |       |-- Immediate mode -> apply one operation -> update tracked version
|   |   |       `-- Batched mode -> queue operation and return provisional ID
|   |   |           `-- Read/barrier or script completion -> flush batch -> mutation receipts
|   |   |-- Live apply -> CanvasSessionBridge.dispatch
|   |   |   `-- Queue command -> wake browser poll -> browser handle(command)
|   |   |       `-- Encode reply -> POST reply -> resolve/reject waiting dispatch
|   |   |-- Proposal apply -> ChangeSessionService.apply
|   |   |   `-- Attachment must match changeSessionId; save_diagram cannot publish a proposal
|   |   `-- Ambiguous transport outcome -> caller retries identical requestId and arguments
|   |       |-- Changed request signature -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |       |-- Exec reruns script and replays completed API outcomes
|   |       |-- Unacknowledged step/batch retains operation IDs, expected version and request ID
|   |       `-- Retry resends uncertain work; it does not silently declare completion
|   |-- Prompt-driven diagram work
|   |   |-- edit/create/extend -> resolve target/context -> start edit or batch run
|   |   |-- Status/cancel -> route to the service retaining that run
|   |   `-- Application callbacks -> bridge dispatch of revision, creation or batch commands
|   |-- Save a live document
|   |   `-- Serialize saves per canvas/document -> request browser checkpoint
|   |       `-- Publish checkpoint -> notify browser that it was saved
|   |           `-- Notification failure -> saved result remains valid; displayUpdated=false
|   `-- Live socket events: publisher and reader have separate roles
|       |-- Publisher registers -> publishes full selection or delta
|       |   `-- LiveCanvasService.update -> validate sequence/regions -> store latest selection
|       |       `-- Same epoch -> notify matching active readers with selection.delta
|       |-- Reader attaches -> bind workspace + document + epoch -> return initial snapshot
|       |   |-- context.get -> load browser context -> recheck identity -> projected context
|       |   `-- copy/paste -> validate binding and request -> notify owning publisher
|       |       `-- Browser reply -> validate owner/receipt -> resolve waiting reader request
|       `-- HTTP selection GET -> read binding -> compare connectionId:sequence ETag
|           |-- Match -> 304
|           `-- Otherwise -> current bound selection and version/epoch headers
|-- [O] Ownership: who retains state and ends its lifetime
|   |-- Owning browser workspace
|   |   |-- Executes live document commands; backend bridge transports them
|   |   |-- Hook allocates ephemeral canvasId and obtains stableWorkspaceId
|   |   |-- Retains at most 200 mutation-command results by command ID
|   |   `-- Cleanup/pagehide -> unregister ephemeral instance
|   |       `-- Effect cleanup also aborts polling, clears retry timer and closes publication
|   |-- CanvasSessionBridge
|   |   |-- Retains descriptors, command queues, poll wakeups and pending dispatch promises
|   |   |-- Poll waits up to 15s; dispatch waits up to 25s
|   |   |-- Reply -> clear timer and pending entry; timeout -> reject and remove queued command
|   |   `-- list() retires registrations untouched for 35s
|   |       `-- Unregister/dispose -> wake pollers and reject outstanding commands
|   |-- AgentDiagrammingSessionService
|   |   |-- Retains attachments, request promises, uncertain exec runs and context-mutation payloads
|   |   |-- Transport ambiguity releases request cache entry so identical retry can recover
|   |   |-- Successful exec removes replay state; completed pure reads release request cache
|   |   `-- Save promise chain is removed when its latest operation settles
|   |-- One QuickJS context per exec run
|   |   |-- Limits: 32 MiB memory, 512 KiB stack, 100 API calls, 4 MiB result payloads
|   |   |-- Interrupts enforce a 30s deadline or interrupt-count limit
|   |   `-- finally -> dispose context, including on failure
|   |-- LiveCanvasService
|   |   |-- Publisher owner token controls its workspace selection mirror
|   |   |-- Reader connectionId retains one workspace/document/epoch binding
|   |   |-- Close, replacement or disconnect -> mark bindings unavailable; notify readers
|   |   |   `-- Reject matching pending copy/paste promises and clear their timers
|   |   |-- Reader socket close -> detach binding; publisher socket close -> disconnect owner
|   |   `-- Copy/paste receipts survive timeouts and are never evicted
|   |       |-- Same scoped request -> reuse command identity and completed result
|   |       `-- Each history caps at 2000; reject new work rather than forget retry identity
|   |-- CanvasApiProjection
|   |   |-- Retains full-ID <-> compact-handle maps for its backend lifetime
|   |   |-- Handles include random generation and revision/hash scope; never reassign them
|   |   `-- Unknown compact handle -> STALE_CONTENT_NODE; reread required
|   `-- Socket transport owns connection timers and queue limits
|       |-- Heartbeat terminates dead peers; close clears handshake timer and service binding
|       |-- Slow readers are closed to reconnect for a snapshot; deltas are not silently dropped
|       `-- Server cleanup -> clear heartbeat, remove upgrade listener, terminate sockets
`-- [D] Data dependency: what each result needs, independent of organization
    |-- Projected canvas nodes and edges
    |   |-- Live/proposal document + canvas state + document version
    |   |-- Display-node derivation also uses cell/endpoint bounds when available
    |   `-- Full domain anchors + projection's retained ID maps [shared A]
    |       `-- The same mapping supports outgoing handles and incoming edge/jump targets
    |-- A valid exec mutation
    |   |-- Attachment identifies canvas/document and optional proposal
    |   |-- Caller expectedVersion equals execution's initial version
    |   |-- Operation arguments + resolved full IDs from [shared A]
    |   `-- Source-mapping changes additionally need current diagram content hash
    |-- A recoverable mutation result
    |   |-- Request scope + requestId + exact argument signature
    |   |-- Frozen operation identity + expected version + retained step/batch receipt
    |   `-- Acknowledgement supplies committed version; timeout alone cannot establish outcome
    |-- Current bound selection [shared B]
    |   |-- Publisher snapshot for document + reader's pinned canvasEpoch
    |   |-- Delta reconstruction needs previous regions and matching baseSequence
    |   |   `-- Remove IDs + upsert regions + new sequence/version -> next selection
    |   `-- Same-epoch updates at or below the retained sequence are ignored
    |-- Live context response
    |   |-- Published selection establishes epoch/readiness from [shared B]
    |   |-- Injected context loader supplies document context
    |   |-- Publisher identity and epoch must remain unchanged across the load
    |   `-- Node/edge projection uses [shared A]; reader binding is rechecked after await
    |-- Confirmed paste result
    |   |-- Bound workspace/document/epoch from [shared B]
    |   |-- Normalized ASCII + position + expectedVersion + retained generated nodeId
    |   `-- Successful reply must match that nodeId and expectedVersion + 1
    `-- Diagram-bound agent-context status
        |-- Current diagram revision and source fingerprint
        |-- Stored context binding + materialized backing record
        `-- No binding -> absent; matching fingerprint -> ready; mismatch -> stale
